text:
{
  "beats": [
    {"anchor": "Not paid, not spent — back.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "the Road had offered him a number that went the right way", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "the knee looked like a thing that had been argued with and won", "kind": "absurd"},
    {"anchor": "Second dusk. So, none.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "That's not a carry, that's a wager.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "Everyone's got a cousin who did it the once.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "She shrugged with the shoulder that still worked.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "The bonus did not send you fast. It sent you alone.", "kind": "undercut"},
    {"anchor": "He walked anyway.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "on a page he'd stopped believing", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "at about the pace of a funeral", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "some week he'd never be introduced to, folded away", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "Four the wrong way.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "like a favour", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "The book said four thousand and three.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "almost kindly", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "laughed once, which hurt his chest, and then stopped", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "[STATUS] wren — Level 2 | HP 13/22", "kind": "system_voice"}
  ]
}

{
  "beats": [
    {"anchor": "which told Wren more about the road than the pause did.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "Mekk's is Mekk's.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "There's a mouse in there I've named.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "Which is the same thing said slower.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "I'm a man with a stamp.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "You've got one arm.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "which meant carrying them the way a man carries a body", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "stopped counting after that", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "which was its own kind of decency.", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "At some hour with no name in it", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "It agreed.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "He turned pages with his thumb bleeding into the corner of them.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "Wren put the books back where they had stood, all of them, exactly.", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "the newer books had quietly stopped printing", "kind": "deadpan"}
  ]
}

{
  "beats": [
    {"anchor": "Now you sit unpriced,", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "still hadn't learned to stop hoping against", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "the way you hear of a flood in another county", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "whatever the window feels like", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "had days the way nineteen-year-olds have days", "kind": "absurd"},
    {"anchor": "didn't know yet that this was the only wealth he'd ever hold", "kind": "undercut"},
    {"anchor": "for less time than it deserved", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "so there were ears on it", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "Not rain — rain would have been a kindness", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "the left shoulder gave up any pretence", "kind": "quip"},
    {"anchor": "not how a man carries and not how a man survives carrying", "kind": "absurd"},
    {"anchor": "where they don't say what happened to the ones who did it once", "kind": "deadpan"},
    {"anchor": "at a speed that was not walking", "kind": "deadpan"}
  ]
}
